name: Fleeca Field

name: Gellhorn International Raceway

desc: The prison where Lucia served time before the story begins.

desc: The iconic hotel from GTA Vice City returns, on Shore Drive, Ocean Beach.

name: Yellow Loot Box (Sundown Private Airfield)
desc: To the right of the small white hut.

name: SCOOP Container (farm)
desc: Next to the farm machinery.

name: Bud: Something Falls from the Sky
desc: You've met Bud before: something falls from the sky. Follow Bud to find out what.

name: SCOOP Container (warehouse)
desc: On the left side of the hall, next to the pallets.

name: Yellow Loot Box (stairs)
desc: From the ground floor, go up the stairs beside the elevator.

name: Cocaine Flamingo (Bayside, chess game)
desc: Take the elevator in the building up to the chess game.

name: Luxury Watch (party house)
desc: Go up the outside stairs and enter through the upstairs door. In the first room on the left, on the table.

name: ATM: Xero Gas Station - Millport
desc: At the Xero gas station.

name: Van Robbery
desc: Two men are loading a van, probably with goods stolen from the store. You can take it: about $1,200 cash in the bag.

name: Book: Ashes of Glory
desc: On a small table in the library inside the building.

name: Cocaine Stash (washing machine)
desc: Hidden in the blue container behind the plank; two packs of drugs in the washing machine.

name: Yellow Loot Box (boxes)
desc: Next to the stack of boxes.

name: Leave the Tower (loudspeaker)
desc: A woman on the loudspeaker tells you to leave the tower. Let her finish, then answer the call.

name: Hawk & Little Mediator
desc: By the hatch on the roof of Janjak's Garage.

name: SCOOP Container (floating platform)
desc: On the floating platform behind all the containers.

name: Former CEO
desc: A man tells you about his past as a CEO and about AI models.

name: Grove Street (San Andreas reference)
desc: A nod to Grove Street from GTA San Andreas.

name: Voice in the Sewer
desc: A voice comes from the drain grate in front of the ice cream shop.

name: Yellow Loot Box (tower)
desc: At the top of the tower, near the card.

name: Yellow Loot Box (store dock)
desc: On a chair in the store's dock area.

name: SCOOP Container
desc: Between two containers.

name: Meteorite Fragment (shore, below the cliff)
desc: Next to a bush by the shore, at the bottom of the cliff.

name: Book: Martha and Lyle's Scrapbook
desc: Inside the old barn at the dead end of a road in Bonanza (the same shed as Lyle's H&L .38).

name: America's Next Top Hooker card: Chastity (Standard)
desc: Inside the warehouse, next to the computer. Second spot for this card.

name: Luxury Watch: Crowex Submerge 'Ratface'
desc: Between the bags next to the couches.

name: SCOOP Container (jewelry)
desc: Orange container with jewelry inside.

name: Sunken Cargo Ship
desc: A sunken cargo ship on the sea floor; a meteorite fragment lies inside.

name: Makeshift Toilet Stash
desc: Kick over the makeshift toilet: cash and drugs.

name: Yellow Loot Box (Paper Boys factory)
desc: Behind the Paper Boys factory. A member found the Vice City Flamingos card Sammy Woodsworth here.

name: Ahol Street Art: Bucket 313
desc: Ocean Beach.

name: Sex Toy Shed
desc: A small shed full of sex toys.

name: Yellow Loot Box (lifeguard tower)
desc: Inside, on the back shelf.

name: Meteorite Fragment (sunken cargo ship)
desc: Enter the ship through the hole: the meteorite is clearly visible.

name: Drunk Woman and the Police
desc: A drunk woman tries to charm the police officers so they don't arrest her.

name: Los Santos Corkers card: Victor Maravilla (Standard)
desc: Starlet Motel: on the fridge in the shared kitchen. Second spot for this card.

name: Yellow Loot Box (cave)
desc: In the cave. A member found the Si-Woo Choo card here.

name: SCOOP Container (Smokescreen Carbon RS)
desc: Use the bulldozer nearby to get to the container. A member found a Smokescreen Carbon RS inside.

name: Bud: Watching the Sky
desc: Bud sits in his truck looking at the landscape and talks about aliens and Area 51 (possibly only at night).

name: Safe (second floor)
desc: In the room on the second floor of the building, on the shelf.

name: Giant Skeleton (underwater)
desc: A huge animal skeleton on the sea floor.

name: Vice City Narcos card: Bryson Powers (Standard)
desc: Starlet Motel. Second spot for this card.

name: Wallet (trailer)
desc: Inside the trailer, on the corner of the bed.

name: Yellow Loot Box (balcony)
desc: On the balcony.

name: Magazine (behind Neptune Rises)
desc: Just behind the Neptune Rises sculpture, below the bridge support, next to the small white chair and bag. On the ground.

name: Shooting Contest (ecologists)
desc: Follow the sound of gunshots and shoot against the ecologists: $250 if you win.

name: Yellow Loot Box (small building)
desc: In the small building.

name: Yellow Loot Box
desc: In the back.

name: Kitty Litter Lab: East La Perle Trailer
desc: The first lab, sent by Dook after Here, Kitty Kitty. Go in through the green gate on the north-west side, turn right, then left after the white van: the green house with purple smoke.

name: Kitty Litter Lab: Crosstown Condo
desc: Laundry van by the plaza entrance on the south side. The lab is apartment 103: the white door on the second floor with purple cans in front.

name: Kitty Litter Lab: Rockridge Lockup
desc: Next to Peterson's Autoshop. Move the laundry van parked beside the shop to uncover the shutter.

name: Kitty Litter Lab: Rockridge Condo
desc: Laundry van by the open gate. Take the stairs on the right of the parking lot: apartment 5, the middle grey door upstairs.

name: Kitty Litter Lab: West La Perle Trailer
desc: Enter the trailer park through the double gate on the east side: the last trailer on the right. The people outside open fire.

name: Kitty Litter Lab: Balsero Trailer
desc: Enter the trailer park from the south-east and turn left: the green-trim trailer with purple smoke, the laundry van at its door.

name: Kitty Litter Lab: South Balsero Lockup
desc: Laundry van by a fence at the alley. Go through the guarded gate ahead: the lab is left of the kitty picture.

name: Kitty Litter Lab: North Balsero Lockup
desc: The shutter is behind the large gate next to the laundry van. Keypad code 1999 (the number on the billboard to the right).

name: Kitty Litter Lab: Decor District
desc: Run through the parking lot from the south and open the shutter.

name: Kitty Litter Lab: Little Cuba Condo
desc: Laundry van in front of the apartments: the lab is the second door on the left.

name: Kitty Litter Lab: Salton Condo
desc: The lab door (top floor, second door) is locked: go round the right side to the back, climb the green dumpster and get in through the open window.

name: Kitty Litter Lab: Salton Lockup
desc: Two laundry vans in the big parking lot. Jump the fence and go left through the gate: the shutter next to the van, with a guard.

name: Kitty Litter Lab: Tequesta Condo
desc: Laundry van by an apartment block with two stairways. Take the right-hand stairs: the lab is the door at the top.

name: Kitty Litter Lab: Vice City Lockup
desc: Run past the laundry van down the alley to the yellow shutters: the one just left of the alley, by the kitty picture.

name: Kitty Litter Lab: Vice-Dale Trailer
desc: Follow the path through the trailer park to the parked car, then climb in through the open window of the white trailer.

name: Kitty Litter Lab: Central Crosstown Lockup
desc: Laundry van in the tattoo parlour's parking lot. The brown shutter is behind the parlour, with a guard in front.

name: Kitty Litter Lab: Central Rockridge Lockup
desc: Laundry van in a parking lot. Go round the right of the building: the lab is behind the brown shutter.

name: Kitty Litter Lab: East Rockridge Condo
desc: Laundry van outside the apartment block. The lab is the white door on the ground floor, at the side of the block.

name: Kitty Litter Lab: North Crosstown Condo
desc: Laundry van in front of the block. Take the stairs in the parking lot: the white door furthest right on the second floor.

name: Kitty Litter Lab: North Crosstown Lockup
desc: The laundry van is parked in front of the shutter.

name: '67 Transgressor part 1/3
desc: Trailer park on Tanglewood Ln, north of Sarena's Bargain Store: a paved spot in the field with the pigs.

name: '67 Transgressor part 2/3
desc: North Port Gellhorn, Gellhorn Ave: go down the right side of the blue house with the sunflower garden to the garage at the back.

name: '67 Transgressor part 3/3
desc: Southern tip of Port Gellhorn: behind a wooden hut next to a broken fence.

name: '70 Riata part 1/3
desc: Sunset Dr, Key Lento, opposite the police impound: under the house, in front of a shed.

name: '70 Riata part 2/3
desc: Southwind, at the end of Cangrejo St (west of the Xero gas station): in the carport.

name: '70 Riata part 3/3
desc: Old Fort Rd, Shoreless Keys, north of Grassrivers Cafe & Deli: behind the abandoned gas station.

name: '64 Mamba GT part 1/4
desc: East Gellhorn, north of Leonida State Prison: open the garage of the grey farmhouse.

name: '64 Mamba GT part 2/4
desc: Ambrosia, in the alley south of the Xero gas station: open the grey garage door of the green building.

name: '64 Mamba GT part 3/4
desc: Broken bridge in north Moreau, north of Buck Creek Country Store: take the path down to the water.

name: '64 Mamba GT part 4/4
desc: In the pond east of the Thrillbilly Mud Club dirt track: the car is in the water.

name: Reynolds Kit Car part 1/5
desc: Salton, Willie's Service Center on SW 7th Ave: break into the garage.

name: Reynolds Kit Car part 2/5
desc: North Casanova Island: behind the wooden gate of a house next to an empty plot.

name: Reynolds Kit Car part 3/5
desc: Wild Hog Point coast, far west of Port Gellhorn: open the SCOOP container.

name: Reynolds Kit Car part 4/5
desc: Watson Bay, Donnie's Auto Repair next to the Pay 'n' Spray: in the alley behind, in front of the shutters.

name: Reynolds Kit Car part 5/5
desc: North-west Capri: the house with two bins opposite a building site. Break into the garage down the right-hand driveway.

name: Southside Storage
desc: Reward for finding all 5 1010 Murals: the garage comes with the unique 1010 Cheetah inside. 1 parking spot.

name: Domestic Timbers
desc: Randy gives you this garage, together with the Tempesta, when you finish his questline (Randy's Wish List). 1 parking spot.

name: No Flusher Tag 6: Mariposa Avenue
desc: On the sidewalk of Mariposa Ave, outside the tan and teal apartment block (north Washington Beach). Scan it with WAiNK.

name: No Flusher Tag 12: Tootsie Katz
desc: On the sidewalk of Cabega St, outside the Tootsie Katz Shrimp House (north Ocean Beach). Scan it with WAiNK.

name: Caledonia Boulevard Garage (GTA+)
desc: The GTA+ garage: GTA+ members claim it together with the Annis Venturas BLVD Elegy, which is parked here.
